phases.g: Know every step with no video and no one to follow. Solo: Hannah's two videos, step by step, copying arms, feet, head and focus at half speed. Apply a teacher's new correction right away. Knees over toes.
Feet, knees, arms, eyes: one fix at a time, and move on once it shows on two videos in a row. Trick preps look like dancing. Thanksgiving week (Nov 23) is light: the memory run only.
Focal points, stamina, costume on: one full-out every session, two back to back on Sundays. 2–3 mini audiences, and tape out the stage size once. Hold every ending.

From Dec 28 fewer runs but still one full-out a session, same days. Nothing new, no deep stretching. Night before the show: memory run or picture it only. Sleep 9–12 hours. Show day Fri Jan 8 (most likely)!

imagery.title: Show in your head (6 min)
script: Stand in your opening pose, in your dance clothes.
Play the real song, full speed.
Close your eyes. See the stage, the lights, the judges' table.
Dance it in your head through your own eyes; let your arms and head mark small.
Feel the story. Slow, calm breaths.
Hold the ending until the very last note.
Do it 2–3 times. The last time, watch yourself from the audience.
imagery.note: Picturing it at bedtime is extra and optional: never let it push bedtime later.
